preregistration_structure.definition: Verifies syntactic and schema completeness of the preregistration document and JSON specification.
preregistration_structure.failure_behavior: Returns FAILED if any required section or field is missing.

preregistration_scientific_readiness.definition: Verifies methodological and experimental rigor, eliminating scientific confounding and leakage.
checks: multi_tiered_leakage_screening (n-gram, MinHash, passage review against test held-out)
early_stopping_guardrails (Hindi regression > 0.05 CE or Sanskrit regression triggers halt)
preregistration_scientific_readiness.failure_behavior: Returns FAILED or REQUIRES_REVISION if any scientific requirement remains unresolved.

protected_file_preservation.definition: Verifies that the protected file chakrview/runtime/session.py has not been modified, staged, or touched in this batch.
protected_file_preservation.evidence: git diff -- chakrview/runtime/session.py matches starting state exactly. Working tree diff untouched.

protected_file_provenance.definition: Verifies historical provenance and origin of pre-existing uncommitted modifications in user workspace.
protected_file_provenance.evidence: mtime 2026-10-11 16:04:15, ChatML session runner modification predating audit batch sequence.
